findings.affected_requirement: FR-023, FR-034, FR-038; SC-001, SC-007, SC-008; canonical-envelope sections 4.5 and 4.8; prepared-scan-contracts IPreparedScanStore steps 3 and 7
findings.evidence: T060 correctly centralizes the normative comparator and ValidatePackage now rejects noncanonical supplied classification sequences before persistence. However, the production detector sorts the complete observations, takes the first 255 when over bound, then appends a BoundExceeded Warning without reordering the retained result. That appended Warning is not always last in the normative order. For example, 257 distinct null-kind MalformedEvidence warnings are initially ordered by rule/path; the appended null-kind BoundExceeded warning sorts before every MalformedEvidence warning because rule ASCII order places BoundExceeded first, but the detector returns it in position 256. PreparedScanPairBuilder passes this detector sequence unchanged into the package. CreateManifest silently sorts tag 26, while PreparedScanRepository.ValidatePackage compares the supplied sequence with the shared comparator and returns Conflict. A valid over-bound Repository therefore cannot atomically persist or expose an approved handoff. The focused CommunicationClassificationTests and PreparedScanAtomicReplayTests pass 9/9 but assert only contract shape/replay and contain no over-256 production sequence; the checked-in T060 PostgreSQL cases cover two untruncated classifications only. QR-001 typed proof/scalar reconstruction and QR2-001 two-row restart replay, normalized tag 26 ordering, and initial deliberately reversed-package rejection are otherwise closed.
findings.correction_outcome: After replacing the omitted tail with the deterministic BoundExceeded Warning, order the final retained set through PreparedScanIdentityBuilders.OrderCommunicationClassifications (or insert the warning at its exact comparator position) before returning it. Add a public detector regression with more than 256 distinct warnings whose BoundExceeded position is not naturally last, proving exactly 256 retained rows, one bound warning, truthful complete totals, EvidenceTruncated=true, and normative order. Add a production/store qualification proving the resulting over-bound package commits and exact restart retry replays without mutation, while an externally reordered package still conflicts before the first durable write.

summary: REVISE. QR-001 and QR2-001/T060 are substantively closed for durable typed proof reconstruction, every manifest scalar and child list, shared canonical classification comparison, tag 26, restart replay, tamper conflict, and deliberately noncanonical first-commit rejection. The approved host pins, PostgreSQL-only Docker topology, source containment, safe XML restrictions, ManagementAccess authorization, cancellation/transaction seams, scoped runtime disposal, and Story 12.3/CodeGraphContext exclusions remain intact. A new HIGH production edge remains: over-bound detector output appends its deterministic Bound Exceeded Warning after the canonical prefix without canonically ordering the final retained list, so the strengthened store validation rejects a legitimate FR-023 package before atomic persistence. Existing tests pass 9/9 but do not exercise the required more-than-256 classification edge, and convergence-08's F8 closure therefore overstates this path. Independent checks verified the pinned commit and artifact hashes, computed the complete binary diff SHA-256, inspected the full story and T060 correction boundaries, and passed candidate git diff --check. Correction is implementation-owned and invalidates convergence and quality review.
